conviction_note: Q3 numbers are new (NEUCA does not pre-release) and the company has beaten the PAP Biznes EBITDA consensus three prints running (+9.1%, +8.6%, +7.4%), with the stock up 3.8%, 4.4% and 2.7% on those mornings. That gives a mild up lean (p_up 57) on a 4.5% move. The findings sum is only +0.2 because two small negatives offset the momentum finding: a hard Q3 2025 comparison (EBITDA 109.2m, beat by 9%) with the September sell-out market slowing to +3.5%, and the chance that the first report after the 500.9m PLN UOKiK fine books a provision and shows a headline net loss. The Q3 2026 bar is unsourced (no PAP consensus found), so every finding is capped small.

already_public.what: UOKiK decision of 21 Sept 2026 fining NEUCA and Swiat Zdrowia a combined 500.9m PLN for an anti-competitive information exchange. Not final, the company is appealing to SOKiK, and payment is due only after a final judgment. The stock fell 13.3% that day (773 -> 670 PLN close). The fine is about 15.5% of market cap at 698 PLN x 4,636,752 shares.

H1 2026 / Q2 2026 results: Q2 EBITDA 98.8m vs PAP consensus 92m, net profit attributable 40.8m vs 35.8m, Q2 pharmacy-wholesale market +6.3% y/y. Management confirmed its full-year market growth forecast at about 6%. No financial forecasts are published for 2026.

Retail pharmacy sell-out (PEX PharmaSequence): July 2026 +4.7% y/y, September 2026 +3.5% y/y, Jan-Sep +5.0%. That implies Q3 of about +5.4% y/y (my arithmetic from the cumulative figures). Refunded-prescription value was -4.5% y/y in September.
No szacunkowe/wstepne wyniki (preliminary results) report found for Q3 2026. NEUCA has no history of pre-releasing quarters.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 EBITDA up y/y on the H1 trend (H1 EBITDA +23%, wholesale gross margin and cost efficiency improving). A beat is more likely than a miss on the three-print record, but the bar is unsourced and the Q3 2025 base is high.

Accounting treatment of the 500.9m PLN UOKiK fine: a provision (headline net loss of several hundred million PLN) or a contingent-liability note. The company calls the charges baseless and won the earlier UOKiK case at the NSA (fine refunded), so I lean to contingent liability, but this is unknown.

NEUCA publishes no financial guidance, only pharmacy-wholesale market growth forecasts. A first 2027 market forecast may appear in the release or at the 20 Nov investor chat, which falls outside the window. Direction unknown.
The policy is +10-15% DPS a year (17.8 PLN paid in 2026). Any comment on whether the potential fine changes it would be new. Unknown; most likely the policy is reiterated.

findings.finding: The Q3 report is the first periodic report since the 21 Sept UOKiK decision (500.9m PLN combined). It must either book a provision, which would show a headline net loss of several hundred million PLN, or disclose a contingent liability. The H1 report calls the charges baseless and records that NEUCA won its previous UOKiK case at the NSA and had the fine refunded, which points to no provision. The headline-loss risk is still real on a thin tape.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The decision itself moved the stock -13.3% on 2026-09-21. There is no precedent here for how the stock reacts to the accounting treatment.
findings.original_quote: Spółka nie zgadza się w całości z zarzutami przedstawionymi w decyzji i zamierza skorzystać z prawa odwołania do Sądu Ochrony Konkurencji i Konsumentów. Ostateczna wysokość ewentualnej kary oraz termin zapłaty zostaną ustalone po zakończeniu postępowania odwoławczego i wydaniu prawomocnego wyroku (The company disagrees in full with the charges and will appeal to the competition court; the final amount and payment date will be set only after a final judgment.)
findings.why_not_priced: The fine is roughly fully priced: the market-cap loss on the day (~478m) is about the size of the fine. What is not known is the accounting presentation and any knock-on to the progressive dividend policy. A provision is a non-cash, already-known amount, so the finding is sized at a fraction of the money.
